solution.description: FPIP (Finance & Procurement Intelligence Platform) core schema — 13 tables, 9 security roles (platform admin uses the built-in System Administrator role).

securityRoles.name: FPIP Procurement
securityRoles.permissions: read/write Requisition, Tender, Bid, PurchaseOrder, RfqSchema, RfqResponse; read Supplier, Contract

securityRoles.name: FPIP Finance
securityRoles.permissions: read/write Invoice; read PurchaseOrder, Contract, Supplier

securityRoles.name: FPIP Auditor
securityRoles.permissions: read-only on all fpip_* tables, no write

securityRoles.name: FPIP HOD
securityRoles.permissions: create Requisition (User depth); read Requisition (Organization depth, for the budget dashboard); no other tables, no write

securityRoles.name: FPIP Budget Owner
securityRoles.permissions: read-only Requisition, Invoice, PurchaseOrder, Supplier; no create/write/delete anywhere

securityRoles.name: FPIP Contract Manager
securityRoles.permissions: create Tender and PurchaseOrder; write Tender (award); read Contract, Requisition, Tender, Bid, PurchaseOrder, ComplianceDocument, Supplier; no delete. See the segregation-of-duties warning in roles.md

securityRoles.name: FPIP Supplier Portal User
securityRoles.permissions: read published RfqSchema; create/read/write only own Bid, Invoice, ComplianceDocument, RfqResponse (referenced Supplier = own); no visibility into other suppliers

securityRoles.name: FPIP Agent Service
securityRoles.permissions: read-only on all fpip_* tables; no create/write/delete/assign/share
